view-01.png.evidence: Two small corners center attention on the blue plane while retaining visible deck markings and both wings.
view-01.png.regressions: The right corner overlays deck clutter and is markedly more conspicuous than the plane against some backgrounds.

view-02.png.evidence: Sharp corners identify the player area through the softer ship and aircraft edges.
view-02.png.regressions: The bracket remains crisper than the aircraft, and there is ambiguity between nearby aircraft and deck cues inside the span.

view-03.png.evidence: Dark aircraft silhouettes and layered rocky terrain converge on a high-energy tracer and fire burst.
view-03.png.regressions: The bright burst occludes several nearby units; overlapping dark forms are harder to parse.

view-04.png.evidence: Two small corners center attention on the blue plane while retaining visible deck markings and both wings.
view-04.png.regressions: The right corner overlays deck clutter and is markedly more conspicuous than the plane against some backgrounds.

view-05.png.evidence: Crisp walls, material changes and tactical paths give rooms a clear structure.
view-05.png.regressions: Unit markers and routes can crowd the narrow hallway; effects are subdued.

view-06.png.evidence: Runway stripes and geometric fields make navigation cues visible.
view-06.png.regressions: Plane is buried in overlaid text, hills and trees are faceted, and offshore flecks lack a shore interaction.

view-07.png.evidence: A pair of high-contrast brackets makes the dark aircraft easy to locate over the blue hangar and keeps its wings visible.
view-07.png.regressions: The left bracket sits over adjacent ground, so the pair reads as a wider targeting overlay in a quiet scene.

view-08.png.evidence: Both bracket strokes remain sharp around the dark aircraft on the softer blue hangar.
view-08.png.regressions: The brackets identify an area wider than the aircraft's silhouette.

view-09.png.evidence: Runway markings, rocks and shoreline form clear landmarks.
view-09.png.regressions: Low contrast around the blue plane, repeated tree blobs and a nearly bare waterline.

view-10.png.evidence: Strong directional light and props give the market density and depth; colored routes identify activity.
view-10.png.regressions: Warm shadows hide figures among crowded stalls, and route lines cross nearby props.

view-11.png.evidence: The contrasting bracket edges guide the eye to the carrier bow even through a very dense swarm.
view-11.png.regressions: An enemy wing near the left corner and another aircraft near the right corner make the selected plane ambiguous inside the span. The gold ring adds another cue in the same area.

view-12.png.evidence: Two high-contrast corners make the controlled area easier to find in the swarm. Crisp wings and smoke retain depth cues.
view-12.png.regressions: An enemy is close to each corner, and the nearby gold ring pulls the eye back toward deck detail. The bracket pair gives a zone more immediately than a single silhouette.

view-13.png.evidence: The brackets remain distinct at reduced detail and keep the player findable against grass and rocks.
view-13.png.regressions: The plane is less distinct than the marker on the softer scenery.

view-14.png.evidence: Carrier tower and plane insignia establish targets clearly away from the bow.
view-14.png.regressions: Soft outlines and wake have little structure; bow overlap compromises player identification.

view-15.png.evidence: Aircraft silhouettes remain distinct away from the deck.
view-15.png.regressions: Center overlay, rounded smoke disks and hard-edged wake flatten the encounter.

view-16.png.evidence: Hard coastline and runway edge organize the frame.
view-16.png.regressions: Tiny overlaid labels and plane compete with the field grid; isolated white flecks distract at sea.

view-17.png.evidence: Paired corners give the player's horizontal position quickly against tan deck, white aircraft and sea. The aircraft silhouette stays clear inside the span.
view-17.png.regressions: The right corner sits near deck trim and the small gold ring still competes at the center of the bow.

view-18.png.evidence: Marked planes stand out on the teal sea and deck markings survive the crowd.
view-18.png.regressions: Effects read as scattered flecks, and selected plane is harder to find in the cluster.

view-19.png.evidence: Wet ground, raking light and shadows create strong volume; rain, smoke and tracer share the scene lighting.
view-19.png.regressions: Dark distant units and shaded infantry are difficult to identify quickly.

view-20.png.regressions: The brackets identify an area wider than the aircraft's silhouette.
